_comment: Example rig config. Every number is a placeholder: survey your own rig. Units: metres, radians. camera.camera_height_m: camera above the marker plane; bots.<id>.led_height: LED height minus marker height (negative below). Both feed the LED-height correction (intrinsics take precedence over camera_height_m).

90.reference_point: marker centre (set marker_offset to use the body centre)
